command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: pre-check /proc/cmdline (should not yet contain audit=1)"
cat /proc/cmdline

echo "STEP: backup /etc/default/grub"
sudo -n cp /etc/default/grub /etc/default/grub.bak.$(date +%s)

echo "STEP: set GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX to include audit=1"
if sudo -n grep -q '^GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX=' /etc/default/grub; then
  sudo -n sed -i 's/^GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX=.*/GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="audit=1"/' /etc/default/grub
else
  echo 'GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="audit=1"' | sudo -n tee -a /etc/default/grub >/dev/null
fi

echo "STEP: verify /etc/default/grub"
grep '^GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX' /etc/default/grub

echo "STEP: run update-grub"
sudo -n update-grub

echo "STEP: verify grub.cfg contains audit=1 on linux lines"
grep -E '^\s*linux ' /boot/grub/grub.cfg | grep -c 'audit=1'
grep -E '^\s*linux ' /boot/grub/grub.cfg | head -5

echo "DONE"
